# Version 3.119.2
> **Servicing and native hardening** · Released February 6, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.3/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.2 adds missing tvOS surface overloads and strengthens native package protections. It also preserves Android symbols for improved diagnostics in deployed applications.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## API Surface

- **tvOS surface creation overloads added** — tvOS applications can use the missing SKSurface.Create overloads already available on the related Apple targets. — ❤️ [@MartinZikmund](https://github.com/MartinZikmund) ([#3342](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3342))

## Platform

- **Android native symbols preserved** — Android symbol assets are packaged for more useful native crash diagnostics. ([#3374](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3374))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.3

HarfBuzzSharp receives the accompanying native binary hardening updates.
